q: What should I do first after registering a company with CIPC?
a: Appoint a public officer for SARS, link the company to your SARS eFiling profile, open a business bank account in the company's name and check your Memorandum of Incorporation. Then set up your website and business email so customers can find and trust you.

q: How do I change directors or officers at CIPC?
a: When a director or officer is appointed, resigns or changes their details, the company notifies CIPC using the CoR39 notice, normally online through CIPC's eServices. Do it when the change happens rather than waiting for the annual return.

q: Do I need a website for my new company?
a: It isn't a legal requirement, but customers, banks and suppliers expect one. A website and an email address on your own .co.za domain make a new company look established. If you sell online, South African law expects you to show your company name, registration number and physical address on the site.
